mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, leading to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real estate starts (HOUST) signals increased demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative or unchanged in > 60% of instances with sustained HOUST increase.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% MoM signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 60% of instances where INDPRO MoM < -2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3% and the CPIAUCSL YoY is above 2%, the combined effect of tight monetary policy and inflationary pressure leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 3% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.5% MoM and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) decrease, the combined signal of labor market weakness leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 60% of instances where UNRATE MoM > 0.5% and PAYEMS < 0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real GDP (GDPC1) signals strong economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative or unchanged in > 60% of instances with sustained GDPC1 increase.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is below its 12-month moving average and real estate starts (HOUST) are decreasing, the combined signal of supply-side weakness leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 12-month MA and HOUST MoM < 0.
